name: the-conductor
description: Marketplace for the conductor/subagent orchestration pattern and its domain skills (Bevy, Rust, TypeScript, Vue3, Blender).

plugins.name: conductor
plugins.description: Conductor orchestrator + 4 subagents (planning, research, implement, code-review) with their preloaded skills; MCP servers come from the baton dependency. Run /baton:setup to enable the Task tools (CLAUDE_CODE_ENABLE_TODO_TOOLS) in the project's .claude/settings.json.

plugins.name: refuter
plugins.description: Refuter orchestrator + 5 subagents (scout, researcher, builder, refuter, auditor) with their preloaded skills; MCP servers come from the baton dependency. Run /baton:setup to enable the Task tools (CLAUDE_CODE_ENABLE_TODO_TOOLS) in the project's .claude/settings.json.

plugins.name: baton
plugins.description: Shared core for the conductor and refuter plugins: context7 + sequentialthinking MCP servers, Task-tools SessionStart hook + /baton:setup, git-diff skill.

plugins.name: statusline
plugins.description: Starship-style powerline statusline: repo/branch + git flags, model + context usage, plan usage with reset countdowns. Wire it in with /statusline:setup.

plugins.name: bevy
plugins.description: Bevy 0.19.1 ECS conventions, plugin architecture, and gameplay patterns. Apply when writing or reviewing Bevy game code.

plugins.name: blender
plugins.description: Blender-to-Bevy workflow conventions using bevy_skein 0.6.0. Apply when writing code that integrates with Blender or uses bevy_skein.

plugins.name: rust
plugins.description: Rust coding standards and conventions. Apply when writing or reviewing Rust files.

plugins.name: typescript
plugins.description: TypeScript coding standards. Apply when writing or reviewing TypeScript or TSX files.

plugins.name: vue3
plugins.description: Vue 3 coding standards with Composition API, Pinia, and TypeScript. Apply when writing or reviewing .vue files and Vue-related composables.
